tools.name: discover_offerings
tools.description: List published ACI offerings in stable, non-commercial order.

tools.name: get_offering
tools.description: Retrieve one published offering's public ACI projection.

tools.name: evaluate_situation
tools.description: Evaluate a structured situation against the published ACI corpus.

tools.name: request_listing
tools.description: Ask ACI to list one offering of the company you act for. Returns a reference, a private listing token (shown once) and the domain-control challenge. ACI is a curated index: a request is reviewed and does not guarantee a listing. Nothing is published until the company approves an exact draft and ACI

tools.name: update_listing_answers
tools.description: Send or correct the company's structured answers. Once a draft exists this requests changes: ACI prepares a new revision from the answers, and any earlier approval no longer counts. A free-text note is read by a person at ACI and is not published.

tools.name: verify_listing_domain
tools.description: Check the domain-control challenge from request_listing (DNS TXT record or file at /.well-known/aci-verification.txt on the company domain).

tools.name: get_listing_status
tools.description: Read the state of a listing request and, once prepared, the full draft with its revision digest and every fact and source.

tools.name: approve_listing
tools.description: Approve publication of the exact draft revision on behalf of the company. Requires a verified domain. Only call after the company has reviewed the draft.
